plain_english: If, in a mirror's belly, the reflection-making with-prototype would be mind-proven — then in the interior of the mirror of free consciousness, among things there is no other cause besides.
sanskrit_cite: ādarśa kukṣau pratibimba kāri sabimbakam syāt yadi mānasiddham svacchanda | saṃvit mukhura antarāle bhāveṣu hetu antaram asti na anyat
